doc: Multiplies by a constant or another PartProgress's value. Set exactly one of 'amount' or 'other'. Applied via PartProgress's 'op'/'operation' field (e.g. `op: mul`), NOT 'type' - its parameter fields (if any) are written flat alongside 'op', on the same object.

other.doc: Another progress function whose value is multiplied instead of a constant.
